title: Jab Chidiya ne poori Army ko hara diya!

lines.text: Australia ki army ek jung haar gayi.
Shocking baat, dushman koi insaan nahi tha.
20,000 dushmanon ne desh gher liya tha.
Inhe rokne ke liye Army bulayi gayi.
Soldiers ke paas heavy Machine-guns thi.
Hazaaron rounds firing bhi be-asar rahi.
Birds ne kamal ki strategy lagayi.
Bullets khatam ho gayi, parinde nahi.
Aakhir mein Army ko surrender karna pada.
Ise kehte hain 'The Great Emu War'.
